subject: Estimating seasonal effect for data with sampling taking place in few months

messages.author: a27036e8db67363a
messages.subject: Estimating seasonal effect for data with sampling taking place in few months
parts:
Dear all,

I would like to include seasonal effect in my model. However, the sampling only took place in few months (see attached) and wondering whether "f(Month,model="seasonal")" specification would be appropriate for this kind of data.

 Thank you for any insight you can give!

Best wishes,

messages.author: 3eab71733027a24a
messages.subject: Re: [r-inla] Estimating seasonal effect for data with sampling taking place in few months
parts:
seems like you have little information to have a seasonal effect, you
add instead a smooth function that is cyclic, like

f(month, model="rw2", scale.model=TRUE,cyclic=TRUE, values=1:12)

where month is one of 1, ..., 12.
